scope: only/sole/last/full-service grocery-store loss, closure, fire, or disaster
canceled or suspended emergency food distributions due to storm, flood, fire, outage, or facility damage
abrupt pantry or food-bank closure or major access reduction
new official SNAP/WIC/food-assistance interruption with immediate access consequences
coverage_notes.result: No new qualifying U.S. food-access disruption was identified in the bounded hourly recall window.
exclusions: Eastport, Maine only-grocery-store closure reporting was several weeks old and outside the window.
Smooth Rock Falls pantry closure was in Ontario, Canada and outside U.S. scope.
Current SNAP search results were policy/eligibility coverage or older interruption stories rather than a new immediate-access interruption in the hourly window.
Non-qualifying recovery/distribution coverage and unrelated fire/closure results were excluded.
coverage_notes.source_priority: Fresh local news, official agency/provider notices, and direct source pages were prioritized.
coverage_notes.production_authority: This supplementary watch is not the primary nationwide collector; production collection remains authoritative.
